## TemplateEngine.MAX\_WIDGET\_CAPTION\_CHARS property

Maximum `<g-widget-caption>` length in characters after entity parsing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static MAX_WIDGET_CAPTION_CHARS: number;
```

## Remarks

Matches the Bot API `sendWidget` caption limit of 1024 characters (source: `https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendwidget`<!-- -->). HTML tags do not count — the length is measured on the caption text with tags stripped. Enforced at validation time (static captions) and re-checked at runtime by `Ctx.assertWidget` (rendered captions).
